newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says to import five mln tonnes wheat.
newsitem.headline: Iran says to import five mln tonnes wheat.

text.p: An Iranian official said Tehran would import five million tonnes of wheat this year in expectation its wheat harvest would fall two million tonnes short of forecasts of 12.6 million tonnes, IRNA news agency said on Sunday.

Deputy Agriculture Minister for Planning Jalal Rasoulov said the wheat harvest in the Iranian year to March 1998 was not expected to exceed 10.5 million tonnes due to a drought which has caused extensive damage in some agricultural regions.

"Last year 13.2 million tonnes of wheat were consumed in the country, 4.9 million tonnes of which were imported," IRNA quoted Rasoulov as saying. "This year...five million tonnes will be imported," he said.
The deputy minister said the amount of rain in Iran had dropped considerably in the past two years compared with previous years.
Rasoulov said 18.8 million hectares (46 million acres) were currently under wheat cultivation across Iran.
